# Freepod

> Freepod is an EU-hosted cloud with two separate uses. Freepod Apps gives anyone a private copy of a curated open-source app, with no technical knowledge needed. Freepod for Developers deploys code you wrote yourself, using the `freepod` command-line client, with or without a coding agent.

Choose by what is being deployed:

- An existing app for everyday use, such as photo storage, file sync or a password manager: use [Freepod Apps](#freepod-apps). This happens on the website and needs no command line.
- A project in a local directory: use [Freepod for Developers](#freepod-for-developers).

## Freepod Apps

For anyone who wants a private alternative to a cloud service. Freepod installs, runs and updates the app.

1. Create an account at [freepod.eu](https://freepod.eu) and choose a handle.
2. Pick an app from the [catalog](https://freepod.eu/apps) and a plan.
3. Launch it. It gets its own HTTPS address, such as `photos-alice.freepod.app`, or can use your own domain.

Creating an account and choosing a plan need a person at a browser. The [getting started guide](https://freepod.eu/docs/apps) has the details.

Apps in the catalog:

- Photos: [Immich](https://freepod.eu/apps/immich) (replaces Google Photos and iCloud Photos), [PhotoPrism](https://freepod.eu/apps/photoprism)
- Files: [Nextcloud](https://freepod.eu/apps/nextcloud)
- Passwords and passkeys: [Vaultwarden](https://freepod.eu/apps/vaultwarden)
- Chat: [Matrix](https://freepod.eu/apps/matrix)
- Team collaboration: [Mattermost](https://freepod.eu/apps/mattermost)
- Forums and communities: [Discourse](https://freepod.eu/apps/discourse), [Lemmy](https://freepod.eu/apps/lemmy)
- Knowledge and wikis: [BookStack](https://freepod.eu/apps/bookstack), [Docmost](https://freepod.eu/apps/docmost)
- Project management: [OpenProject](https://freepod.eu/apps/openproject)

## Freepod for Developers

For code you wrote yourself, by hand or with a coding agent. The `freepod` client builds a container from your source, with no Dockerfile needed, and puts it live on its own hostname. Postgres, object storage and sign-in are built in.

Install the client with any one of:

```bash
uv tool install freepod
pip install freepod
brew install erikvanzijst/tap/freepod
```

If you use a coding agent, install the skill that teaches it how to build and deploy for Freepod, then let it read the skill before changing the project:

```bash
freepod skill install
```

Deploy from the project directory. `freepod login` needs a person at a browser.

```bash
freepod login
freepod init
freepod deploy
```

- [Freepod for developers](https://freepod.eu/dev)
- [Developer docs](https://freepod.eu/docs/developers)
- [Coding agents](https://freepod.eu/docs/developers/coding-agents)
